description: Read an app's audit trail: who deployed, who changed env vars or secrets, who was granted access, every MCP tool call against it, newest first. Needs the app.audit.view permission on that app (default: the app owner, app admins and platform admins; plain members are refused unless the role matrix grants it). Paginate with before: pass the next_before value from the previous page to get older rows; next_before is null on the last page. limit defaults to 50, max 200. action filters by a substring of the action name, e.g. "deploy", "env", "mcp.appcrane_set_secret". Credential-bearing fields in detail are shown as [redacted].

action.description: Only rows whose action contains this text.

before.description: Return rows with an id lower than this (the next_before of the previous page).

name: appcrane_get_audit
